title: Competition filter advertises Serie B/Serie C but no such data is provided
evidence: src/bsmcp_tools.erl:21 lists 'Serie B, Serie C' as competition filters; data/kaggle/ ships only Brasileirao Serie A, Copa do Brasil and Libertadores. bsmcp_names:competition/1 maps them but no rows exist, so those filters return empty gracefully.
suggestion: Trim the tool description to the competitions actually loaded, or note they are unpopulated.

title: Extended-stats file (corners/shots/attacks) is loaded for match unification but its rich columns are unused
evidence: src/bsmcp_data.erl:234 load_extended parses BR-Football-Dataset.csv but only date/teams/goals feed queries; corner/shot/attack stats are not surfaced by any tool.
suggestion: Optional: add a tool exposing shots/corners aggregates, or document that only scores are used.
